{{Quote|I am your ''honores.'' Your translation might be ''chaperone.''|Lokir-Ka|<ref name="Star Wars: The Old Republic">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''</ref>}}
An '''honores''' was a title held amongst the [[Voss (species)|Voss]] that was used to designate those that served as a guide to outsiders during their stay on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]]. [[Lokir-Ka]] served in this role to a [[Voidhound|smuggler]] that had arrived on [[Voss]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] era. During an adjudicator hearing, [[Mirev-Ka]] accused the smuggler of corrupting the moral health of an honores.
